items.title: Compact centered photo presentation
items.precondition: Signed in with a conversation that contains one portrait image and one landscape image.
steps: Open each image from its message bubble at desktop width.
Confirm the visible 'Image preview' label, header separator, opaque dialog panel, and broad inner padding are absent.
Resize to a narrow/mobile viewport and open both images again.
items.expected: Each image appears as a centered floating object, never exceeds 70vh height or 24rem width, fits within the viewport, and has no broad white frame around it.
items.evidence: User-validated locally on 2026-08-19, including mobile visual validation.
items.notes: The compact X continues to use difference blending to maintain contrast without a visible background.

items.title: Accessible dismissal behavior
items.precondition: A received image is available in a signed-in conversation.
steps: Open the image and confirm keyboard focus lands on the visible overlay Close action.
Close once with the overlay control, once by clicking the shaded backdrop, and once with Escape.
For each close path, confirm the viewer closes and the page scrolls normally afterward.
Inspect the open dialog with accessibility tooling or its rendered attributes.
items.expected: All dismissal paths work, closing restores page scrolling, and the dialog has an accessible name even though no visible title is rendered.
items.notes: The existing backdrop, Escape listener, focus ref, and scroll cleanup remain intact; the dialog has aria-label='Chat image'.

items.title: Click-to-zoom photo toggle
items.precondition: A received image is open in the chat photo viewer.
steps: Activate the compact photo with a pointer and confirm it enlarges.
Activate the enlarged photo again and confirm it returns to compact size.
Repeat with keyboard activation, then verify both states at a narrow/mobile viewport.
items.expected: The photo toggles only between compact and enlarged viewport-contained states; its accessible control state changes with the visual state, and Close remains visible and usable.
items.evidence: User-validated locally on 2026-08-19, including mobile visual validation.
items.notes: Continuous zoom and panning are out of scope.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: All commands exit successfully with no errors caused by this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-19: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, npm --prefix frontend run lint, and npm --prefix frontend run build completed successfully after click-to-zoom implementation.
items.notes: Lint emitted six pre-existing warnings outside the changed file. Vite emitted its existing large-chunk advisory.
